title: Move survey data collection to GeoData
summary: GeoData owns survey data collection, the 3D terrain map and its export. We restate the mission as approved-route execution with controlled stops and a steady sensor platform. We keep requirement IDs R-07 and R-08 and plan no work under them. We record that mapping issue #19 closed as not planned and keep the approved M1 fixture and limits as a record. The interface between this project and GeoData acquisition remains undefined. We change no experiment result, acceptance gate or test.
next: Agree with GeoData on the stop status and pose that its acquisition needs, then assign an owner and reviewer for issue #20.
